fact: BIIC and ADPME launched the FAEN programme to finance start-ups holding the 'start-up' label in seed phase (under 3 years) and growth-stage SMEs.

Decree No. 2023-095 of 22 March 2023, signed by the President on the digital minister's proposal, sets how the 'start-up' label is granted to micro, small and medium firms, with labelled start-ups given the tax incentives of the General Tax Code.
